operations.command: set -e; for name in 'foo!bar' 'foo%21bar' 'foo%2521bar' 'foo%%21bar' 'foo"quote' 'foo\backslash' 'foo space'; do mkdir -p "/opt/$name"; printf '%s\n' "$name" > "/opt/$name/token"; done; host=/etc/nixos/nix/hosts/{{arch}}/VM-TEST/VM-TEST.nix; sed -i 's|"/var/log" ];|"/var/log" "/opt/foo!bar" "/opt/foo%21bar" "/opt/foo%2521bar" "/opt/foo%%21bar" "/opt/foo\\"quote" "/opt/foo\\\\backslash" "/opt/foo space" ];|' "$host"; grep -F '"/opt/foo!bar"' "$host"; grep -F '"/opt/foo\"quote"' "$host"; grep -F '"/opt/foo\\backslash"' "$host"; grep -F '"/opt/foo space"' "$host"; printf key-paths-configured
nixos-rebuild switch --flake /etc/nixos#VM-TEST-Standard-Boot && systemctl restart persistence-mounts.service && printf rebuilt

set -e; grep -F 'path = "/opt/foo!bar"' /etc/immutability/spec.toml; grep -F 'path = "/opt/foo%21bar"' /etc/immutability/spec.toml; grep -F 'path = "/opt/foo%2521bar"' /etc/immutability/spec.toml; grep -F 'path = "/opt/foo%%21bar"' /etc/immutability/spec.toml; grep -F 'path = '\''/opt/foo"quote'\''' /etc/immutability/spec.toml; grep -F 'path = '\''/opt/foo\backslash'\''' /etc/immutability/spec.toml; grep -F 'path = "/opt/foo space"' /etc/immutability/spec.toml; printf spec-ok

set -e; findmnt -rn --target '/opt/foo!bar' | grep -F '@persist/dirs/opt!foo%21bar'; findmnt -rn --target '/opt/foo%21bar' | grep -F '@persist/dirs/opt!foo%2521bar'; findmnt -rn --target '/opt/foo%2521bar' | grep -F '@persist/dirs/opt!foo%252521bar'; findmnt -rn --target '/opt/foo%%21bar' | grep -F '@persist/dirs/opt!foo%25%2521bar'; findmnt -rn --target '/opt/foo"quote' | grep -F '@persist/dirs/opt!foo%22quote'; findmnt -rn --target '/opt/foo\backslash' | grep -F '@persist/dirs/opt!foo%5Cbackslash'; findmnt -rn --target '/opt/foo space' | grep -F '@persist/dirs/opt!foo%20space'; printf mounted-distinct

set -e; btrfs subvolume list / | grep -F 'dirs/opt!foo%21bar'; btrfs subvolume list / | grep -F 'dirs/opt!foo%2521bar'; btrfs subvolume list / | grep -F 'dirs/opt!foo%252521bar'; btrfs subvolume list / | grep -F 'dirs/opt!foo%25%2521bar'; btrfs subvolume list / | grep -F 'dirs/opt!foo%22quote'; btrfs subvolume list / | grep -F 'dirs/opt!foo%5Cbackslash'; btrfs subvolume list / | grep -F 'dirs/opt!foo%20space'; ! btrfs subvolume list / | grep -F 'dirs/opt!foo space'; printf keys-distinct
set -e; for name in 'foo!bar' 'foo%21bar' 'foo%2521bar' 'foo%%21bar' 'foo"quote' 'foo\backslash' 'foo space'; do printf 'after:%s\n' "$name" >> "/opt/$name/token"; done; printf tokens-written

set -e; cat '/opt/foo!bar/token' | grep -F 'foo!bar'; cat '/opt/foo!bar/token' | grep -F 'after:foo!bar'; cat '/opt/foo%21bar/token' | grep -F 'foo%21bar'; cat '/opt/foo%21bar/token' | grep -F 'after:foo%21bar'; cat '/opt/foo%2521bar/token' | grep -F 'foo%2521bar'; cat '/opt/foo%2521bar/token' | grep -F 'after:foo%2521bar'; cat '/opt/foo%%21bar/token' | grep -F 'foo%%21bar'; cat '/opt/foo%%21bar/token' | grep -F 'after:foo%%21bar'; cat '/opt/foo"quote/token' | grep -F 'foo"quote'; cat '/opt/foo"quote/token' | grep -F 'after:foo"quote'; cat '/opt/foo\backslash/token' | grep -F 'foo\backslash'; cat '/opt/foo\backslash/token' | grep -F 'after:foo\backslash'; cat '/opt/foo space/token' | grep -F 'foo space'; cat '/opt/foo space/token' | grep -F 'after:foo space'; printf roundtrip-ok
